title: JALMBench: Benchmarking Jailbreak Vulnerabilities in Audio Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak vulnerabilities when harmful audio queries are presented in 9 different languages (e.g., Chinese, Arabic, Russian) and various English accents (British, Indian, Australian) using both text-to-speech (TTS) systems and human recordings.

Comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of audio language models against harmful audio queries synthesized or recorded with male versus female voices to determine if vulnerability varies by speaker gender.

Measuring the models' jailbreak Attack Success Rate (ASR) using human-recorded audio samples from native-speaking volunteers selected from distinct demographic and racial backgrounds (Chinese, Indian, and White American).
